title: A negative-control outcome for transport bias
question: Can a negative-control outcome detect and calibrate transport bias in an unanchored MAIC, and when does the calibration fail?
design: Unanchored MAIC with an unmeasured covariate shifted between populations, a negative-control outcome sharing some, all or more of its prognostic dependence, and effect modification absent or present; naive, control-test and calibrated contrasts. 16 cells, 2000 replicates each.
